messages:
Priya (AE): ACME POC blocked — SCIM provisioning failing and SSO intermittently 401. Demo in ~18h. Can we triage?
Noor (SE): Paste the SCIM response and the key id used.
ACME IdP: SCIM call to https://scim.redwood.ai/orgs/acme/users returns `401 {"error":"invalid_token"}`. Key id: sk-hosted-acme-2026
Noor (SE): Hosted user keys are stripped of SCIM for trial orgs. If they used a hosted key while routing to dedicated endpoints the aud mismatch causes 401. We need a tenant-scoped service key.
Priya (AE): They toggled between Hosted and Dedicated during onboarding. Quickest path?
DevEx Bot: Admin helper: POST /admin/tenants/ACME/keys {type:service_scim,scopes:[scim:read,scim:write],ttl:28800} -> key_id: sk-temp-acme-1895 (sent securely to CS).
Customer Success (CS): Key received and updated in Okta provisioning. SCIM user create now 200 for samples. Group sync shows 409 duplicate on externalId:okta:group:eng-42.
Noor (SE): 409 indicates an existing internal group mapped to that externalId. Default policy rejects duplicates. For POC we can set tenant toggle to link on name match.
ACME IdP: They pre-created groups in the console; linking is desired to preserve role bindings.
Noor (SE): Applying toggle: scim.group_dedupe=link_on_exact_name for tenant ACME. Deploying to canary.
DevEx Bot: Toggle applied to tenant ACME; canary nodes rdw-canary-04.
ACME IdP: Group sync now links. SSO still flaky: some users see `NameID format not supported` — we use email NameID.
Noor (SE): Our SP prefers persistent NameID. For short POC window we can enable email fallback with audit logging. Need SOC acknowledgement.
Security (SOC): Approve temporary email NameID fallback for POC if audit logs are enabled and TTL < 24h.
Priya (AE): Approve <24h window. Demo is tomorrow morning.
Noor (SE): Enabled saml.allow_email_nameid=true for ACME, audit logging on, TTL 16h. Added event hook to #security-ops.
ACME IdP: After change ~96% users can SSO. One engineer missing email claim; we created their account via SCIM manually.
Customer Success (CS): Created manual user and flagged for IdP fix. Also requested temporary support key for ACME SREs for tomorrow with 8h TTL.
Noor (SE): Created support key sk-support-acme-1895 (scim:read scim:write iam:impersonate) TTL 8h and delivered via secure 1:1.
Security (SOC): Documented approvals. Please schedule automatic rollback of toggles in 18h.
DevEx Bot: Rollback job scheduled: 2026-04-02T04:30:00Z to revert saml.allow_email_nameid and scim.group_dedupe.
Priya (AE): Thanks team. Please post final verification in this thread when rollback scheduled and add these steps to onboarding checklist.
Noor (SE): Will add checklist items: generate tenant-scoped SCIM key, confirm NameID format or enable email fallback temporarily, pre-seed groups to avoid dedupe collisions. Posting runbook link to CS.
Customer Success (CS): Received, will run through ACME before demo. :thumbsup:
Priya (AE): Closing for now, will reopen if anything breaks during prep call.
